tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidders should have provided at least 100 Man power per year (Subject to minimum of 25 Man Power per contract) to one or more Departments / Undertakings /Organizations/ Corporations/ Boards of State or Central Government in last 3 financial years (i.e., 2023-242024-25& 2025-26) and should have rendered services satisfactorily. i) Should provide the summery of Work Order/agreement details in the format provided in the tender document. The page Nos. of the documentary proof submitted should be mentioned in the format. Please note that the documents uploaded but not mentioned in the format will not be considered for evaluation. ii) Documentary proof in the form of certificate issued by the Department/Organization/Undertaking/Corporation/Boards of State or Central Government for satisfactory services rendered shall be scanned and uploaded i.e., agreements/ work orders & satisfactory performance certificate etc. NWKRTC will verify the documents with the concerned wherever necessary. iii) Should upload the documents pertaining to the required i.e., 2023-242024-25& 2025-26 only. At the same time, only the Work Orders, Agreements etc with minimum of 25 Man Power per contract in this period should be uploaded. The details of the documents should be mentioned in the format. Uploading of high Nos. of documents of previous period and lesser manpower is not called for which will lead to disqualifying of the bidder. iv) In case, the documents submitted are with Measurement of Unit other than the Man Power supplied per year, i.e. unit of measurement in Man Hours, Many Days and/or value of the contract, the bidder should submit the documents issued by the organization by converting the same to Man Power. In case of non-submission of such certificates issued by the concerned organization, such documents will not be considered for evaluation.

The Bidders shall necessarily possess following documents at the time of uploading the tender and should upload the same in the e- procurement portal. i. Certification of Incorporation under Shops and Commercial Establishment Act 1961 issued by Department of Labour. ii. Provident Fund Registration Certificate issued by the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner. iii. Combined Challan having TRRN No. for having remitted PF returns to PF authority for all the 36 months of last three Financial Years (i.e., 2023-242024-25& 2025-26). iv. GST Registration Certificate. v. Certificate of Registration under Professional Tax Act. vi. Copy of the PAN Card of the Bidders/ Proprietors. vii.Documents for having paid the Labour Welfare Fund for at least 50 employees to Labour Department during last three years (i.e., 2023-242024-25 & 2025-26) put together.
The bidders should submit an undertaking to open an office in respective division on successful selection in the tender
The Financial bids of the agencies which do not meet the Pre-Qualifying Requirements (Technical Bids) will not be considered.
The bidder should quote for providing Technical Assistants of Heavy Passenger vehicle.

The Bidder must have minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 2.00 Crore during any of the three years out of last five years (i.e., for 2023-242024-25& 2025-26) from providing Man power supply Services. They need to submit duly supported Audited Statement of Accounts i.e. Profit/Loss Statements, Balance Sheets and GST returns for three years out of last four years i.e. for 2023-242024-25& 2025-26. The Bidders should submit photo copies of the audited statement of accounts sealed and signed by self (bidder) and the Chartered Accountant along with the pre-qualification offer. CA certificate in the format prescribed shall be uploaded in the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.
